answer: In PoA, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, while reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so an identity must provide sustained honest service to retain eigenvector centrality. A freshly spawned sybil starts near zero, and isolated collusion cannot manufacture trusted mass or pass consensus. Even a tundra of umber accounts exchanging a whisper of approval remains negligible under normalization and temporal decay.
